card.name: Section numbers in cross-references
card.fires_on: The first digit of a section number inside parentheses, mostly a 5 after a warnings sentence in a label's highlights, such as (5.1). Also the 9 starting an ISBN prefix of 978.

modes.label: Warnings section reference
modes.description: The digit 5 opening a parenthetical pointer to a Warnings and Precautions subsection at the end of a highlights sentence.

modes.label: Other section numbers
modes.description: The first digit of a two-digit section number in a cross-reference to clinical sections.

modes.label: ISBN prefix
modes.description: The 9 that begins the 978 or 979 book-number prefix.

card.writes: It promotes digit-continuation and punctuation tokens such as the period and 'th', suggesting the number or decimal continues.
card.plain: It marks the first digit of a section number in brackets, such as (5.1), that points to another part of the label.
